description: A ground-level photograph depicting a non-irrigated permanent crop area, consistent with CORINE Land Cover (CLC) category 2.2.1, such as an orchard or grove. Trees are arranged in rows on dry, brown earth covered with fallen leaves and sparse green undergrowth. A low, dry-stone wall runs along the left side of the frame. In the immediate foreground, an open blue binder or notebook rests on the ground, but its textual content is unreadable. This landscape is characteristic of Mediterranean zones, where non-irrigated fruit trees like almonds, carob (*Ceratonia siliqua*), or cherries are cultivated.
